summary: This is a DeepSeek Harness orchestration plugin that stages tool actions in a batch inbox, lets users review full call details, and submits an approved batch for execution.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is primarily an agent-side action orchestration tool for DeepSeek Harness: it stages intended tool calls, provides an Inbox for full-call review and optional edits, and requires a review-based approval step before dispatching committed actions. Evidence shows it is designed for workflow control of external side-effect operations (for example tool actions targeting GitHub, Slack, deploy flows), with persistent state and recovery handling, so its purpose is not coding or content generation but controlled orchestration and human-in-the-loop approval.
